node.html: Built a feedforward modularized neural network from scratch with tunable parameters and architecture. Trained it on the MNIST dataset.
Built a memory management module with automated caching on a simulated xv6 machine with limited memory as an academic project.
Built a ray tracer from scratch using the OpenGL library in C++ as an academic project.
Built a full-fledged compiler able to translate basic C syntax to x86 machine code.
Built a shooter game on hardware using an ATMega32 as the main computing unit. Used gyroscopes and IR sensors to control the movement and input actions of the player.
Built a car warehouse management system with a GUI based on JavaFX. Used Java socket programming to simulate a real time market through the purchase and selling of cars.
Built a “shoot 'em up” game as the very first academic project of my undergraduate years. The player assumes the role of superman and uses his superpowers to fight evil.
